name: Exhausted Plunge
description:
The character to which this is attached takes +1 DMG.
This effect starts off with 3 "Takeoff Countdown Points."
After the attached character uses a skill: Lose 1 "Takeoff Countdown Point." Once all "Takeoff Countdown Points" are removed, this effect is removed, and the character returns to "Skyward Patrol" status.
